title: Un continente dividido
goal: Read a closing synthesis of how thoroughly Cold War polarization touched universities, unions and militaries across Latin America, setting up the coups and repression to come.
grammar: No hay + sustantivo + que no: una afirmación universal

items: Explain what's hard to find when reviewing this unit as a whole.
Describe how professors and students often organized at universities.
Explain the dynamic that affected practically every labor union in the region.
State what element every Latin American military eventually adopted.
Use no hay + noun + que no + subjunctive to make a sweeping universal claim.
